about.title: About ToolNest
about.metaDesc: ToolNest delivers fast, ad-free, browser-native micro-tools that respect user privacy with zero data storage.
about.heading: Micro-tools that respect your time and data.
about.subheading: Fast, private, and free utilities designed to solve everyday dilemmas without bloated ads, required sign-ups, or invasive tracking.
about.philosophyP1: The modern web has become cluttered with slow page loads, forced account registrations, intrusive cookie popups, and battery-draining ad scripts just to use basic utilities like a decision wheel or age calculator.
about.philosophyP2: ToolNest is engineered as a clean alternative: single-purpose tools that run directly in your browser, process calculations offline where possible, and never store your personal choices on our servers.
about.methodologyP1: Calculations and data entry in ToolNest occur in your local browser session. Whether you spin the decision wheel, compute birthday facts, or time an upcoming vacation, your inputs are stateless and private.
about.editorialP1: Every tool is designed with mathematical precision. Our decision wheels and random pickers leverage Web Cryptography API algorithms to guarantee unbiased, tamper-proof probability.
about.techP1: Powered by Astro and deployed to Cloudflare Workers across 300+ edge locations globally for sub-50 millisecond load times.
about.contactDesc: Have an idea for a new micro-tool or feedback on an existing one? We would love to hear from you.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDesc: ToolNest privacy policy: zero tracking, zero personal data retention, client-first computation.
privacy.heading: Zero tracking. Zero accounts. Zero data collection.
privacy.introP: At ToolNest, we believe online utilities should not require surrendering personal privacy. We do not require accounts, we do not build advertising profiles, and we do not sell data to third parties.
privacy.collectP1: When you use tools like the Age Calculator, Birthday Facts, Decision Wheel, or Random Picker, all mathematical evaluations happen locally in your web browser.
privacy.collectP2: We do not store your entered birth dates, decision options, event names, or participant lists on any database server.
privacy.cookiesP1: We use minimal client-side localStorage and lightweight cookies strictly for user preferences (such as remembering your dark/light theme and chosen interface language). No tracking or third-party advertising cookies are used.
privacy.analyticsP: Our website is hosted on Cloudflare Workers. Cloudflare collects basic aggregate request telemetry (such as total hits and country-level geolocation for language routing) without tracking individual visitors.
privacy.urlP: When you share a countdown timer or decision wheel, options are encoded directly into the URL hash or query string. Anyone with the link loads the exact same client configuration without server lookups.
